Corrugated packaging — annual contract

RFx-CP-2627-001 · 30 lines · ₹3–3.5 crore a year · contract 1 Nov 2026 – 31 Oct 2027 · RFx sent 22 Sep, five responses received over nine days.

RFx copilot

Describe what you need. The copilot asks what it must and drafts a structured RFx — line items, specifications, questionnaire, terms — that you can edit directly.

What are you sourcing? A rough description is enough — for example volumes, where it ships, and anything quality-critical.

Email threads

One private thread per supplier. Sending is simulated (no real SMTP), but every message you send is recorded here. Inbound content is exactly what the extraction model reads.

Vendor responses

Each response is read by the model as-is — no template required. The model only transcribes and maps; all arithmetic happens afterwards in code.

Comparison

Same lines, same unit, same currency: landed INR per RFx unit, ex-GST. Every number traces to a snippet in the supplier's own document.

Knowledge base

The buyer's rules. Supplier responses are evidence; these rules decide what “good” means and are applied identically to every supplier.

AI analyst

Ask anything about the event in plain language. The model picks tools and explains; the numbers come from the same deterministic engine as every other screen. Expand ⚙ to see each tool call.

Ask about prices, eligibility, what's uncertain, or a what-if. I'll say so when the responses don't contain the answer.
